name: HWM_TCD_EXP_DATA_SCH
description: This table contains details for Time Clock Device export data for Schedule

columns.name: SCHEDULE_DATA_ID
columns.description: System generated number to uniquely represent the schedule data record

columns.name: TCD_EXP_DATA_ESS_PROCESS_ID
columns.description: The process which generated the data.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Export or Collection Data Status

columns.name: DELETE_FLAG
columns.description: Used for soft delete of the row

columns.name: SCHEDULE_DATA_VERSION
columns.description: Version of the schedule data record

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Person id

columns.name: SCH_REC_ID
columns.description: Schedule record id

columns.name: SCH_REC_VERSION
columns.description: Schedule record version

columns.name: SHIFT_ORIGIN
columns.description: Source of the shift. Values are like employment shedule, absences, holiday etc

columns.name: LATEST_VERSION
columns.description: Latest version of the schedule data record

columns.name: SHIFT_ID
columns.description: SHIFT_ID

columns.name: START_TIME
columns.description: Schedule shift start date and time

columns.name: END_TIME
columns.description: Schedule shift end date and time

columns.name: REC_TYPE
columns.description: The type of the record like created, modified, deleted

columns.name: SETUP_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: The setup profile id driving the export data collection.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Enterprise id

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
